alt.zh-CN: 透明记忆库连接三个信息孤岛，汇聚知识卡片的概念插画。
alt.en: A transparent memory vault connects three information islands and brings knowledge cards together.

alt.zh-CN: 由单个助手延伸成多工具协作机器的工作流概念插画。
alt.en: A single assistant grows into a coordinated machine of interconnected workflow tools.

alt.zh-CN: 晨光下陈列在托盘中的三个 AI 与自动化工具模型。
alt.en: Three AI and automation tool models displayed in a tray in the morning light.

alt.zh-CN: 两岸服务器通过跨海光缆相连，旁边有航行的货船。
alt.en: Servers on distant shores connected by an undersea cable, with cargo ships nearby.

alt.zh-CN: 连接店铺、包裹传送带和国际港口的自动化运营循环。
alt.en: An automation loop connects a storefront, parcel conveyor and international ports.

alt.zh-CN: 放大镜从全球业务网络中聚焦工厂、批发货物与采购决策者模型。
alt.en: A magnifying lens focuses on a factory, wholesale cargo and a buyer figure within a global business network.

alt.zh-CN: 直播设备通过信号路径连接海外店铺与包裹的概念插画。
alt.en: Live-streaming equipment connects to overseas storefronts and parcels through curved signal paths.

alt.zh-CN: 抽象城市模型中的区域被高亮，定位标记表示地域投放规划。
alt.en: Selected areas of an abstract city model are highlighted for geographic campaign planning.

alt.zh-CN: 聊天沟通与独立店铺两条路径汇合到订单包裹的概念插画。
alt.en: Two paths, customer conversations and an online store, converge on an order parcel.

alt.zh-CN: 机械臂、知识卡片和模块化工具连接成可组合的开源工具箱。
alt.en: A mechanical arm, knowledge cards and modular tools form a connected open-source toolkit.

alt.zh-CN: 打开的笔记本延伸向远方，纸鸟象征个人知识博客的开始。
alt.en: An open notebook leads toward a distant horizon, with a paper bird marking the start of a knowledge blog.

alt.zh-CN: 围绕目标工厂连接多个专业角色的 B2B 账号营销概念插画。
alt.en: A network of professional figures surrounds a selected factory in an account-based marketing concept.

alt.zh-CN: 摄像机的视频帧沿两条服务器路径传向屏幕的网络测试概念插画。
alt.en: Video frames travel from a camera through two server routes toward a screen in a network-testing concept.
